summary: Village Capital still hosts IBM Hyper Protect Accelerator information, but the page identifies its program as 2022 and mixes closed Cohort 5 with year-round Friends of Hyper Protect copy.

sources.title: IBM Hyper Protect Accelerator — delivery partner

notes: No 2026 cohort or current application period was confirmed. Do not renew old dates or assume the undated Friends offer is still accepting applications.
Historical benefits included investment readiness, technical mentorship and up to $120K IBM Cloud credits; these are not reverified as current offers.
